page.overview:
Who is Bazooka?

Bazooka was killed by Storm Shadow so that he would not disrupt the ninja's attack on the U.S.S. Flagg. Storm Shadow placed a small letter in Bazooka's mouth challenging Snake-Eyes to face him alone on a deserted island. The discovery of Bazooka's corpse caused the Joes to become more serious about taking down Cobra.
